Dispatched via data_fd2_chapter_end_handler_table[29] (sole xref from 0x51e59 = end-handler dispatch table; verified dword 0x2548C at table+0x14). Name correctly reflects purpose and body (chapter 29 end handler).
purpose: Chapter 29「無邊的黑暗之中」end handler: a straight-line dramatic cutscene (no branch, no char added) that transmutes party slot 0x14 into its 變身 form, plays three earthquake rounds with white-flash climax, then a palette fade-out/black-screen/fade-in transition before advancing the chapter id.
logic_summary: Calls __CHK(0x2C) Watcom stack probe; shows dialog page 10; fd2_kill_runtime_chars_from_index_to_end(0x14) wipes active slots from 0x14 to party tail; overwrites runtime_char[0x14].portrait_id and .char_id with 0x7E (變身 form); shows page 11; reloads chapter portraits into FD2.TMP (race 9); pans cursor/window to (9,8); animates cursor to tile (0xF,10); warps last party member (party_member_count-1) onto (0xF,10); shows page 12; resets battle_anim_phase=0. Then three earthquake rounds interleaved with pages 13/14/15 (each round resets battle_anim_phase=0 first): round1 shake0x14/600ms/shake0x14/600ms/shake0x14; round2 shake0x14/200ms/shake0x14/200ms/shake0x14; round3 shake0x14/200ms/shake0x14/100ms/triple-strength shake0x28/200ms then 3x white palette-flash pulses with 300ms holds, then page 15. Finishes with a 64-step palette fade-out (brightness 0->0x3F, 4ms/step), memset framebuffer 0xA0000 to 0 held 800ms, 63-step palette fade-in (0x3E->0, 4ms/step), then fd2_save_runtime_char_to_template() and current_chapter_id += 1.

returns.semantics: No return value; performs the chapter-29 end cutscene for its side effects and advances data_fd2_chapter_current_chapter_id.
